definitions.explanation: lacking in earnestness or diligence; not taking things seriously when one should

examples.japanese: {不真面目|ふまじめ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不真面目|ふまじめ}だ。
examples.english: He's not serious about his work.

examples.japanese: {不真面目|ふまじめ}な⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: The unserious students were scolded by the teacher.
